deal.name: IdeaBuddy
deal.tagline: Bring your business ideas to life with our all-in-one business planning software, powered by AI

plans.name: IdeaBuddy
terms: Lifetime access to IdeaBuddy Founder Plan
You must redeem your code within 60 days of purchase

signals.label: Hidden caps
signals.finding: Usage is metered (credits or quotas) on the vendor's pages.

evidence.quote: Get smart suggestions and enhance your writing automatically with our new AI Assistance feature. Request credits refill with each billing cycle.
The validity of AI request credits aligns with your plan's duration and is refilled at the end of each billing cycle.

signals.label: Discount size
signals.finding: $69 vs a stated $1440 regular price (95% off).

signals.label: One-sided change clauses
signals.finding: The terms let the vendor change features or pricing at any time.

evidence.quote: We may update this Agreement or the Privacy Policy at any time, without notification to you.
Deep Blue Sea Studio may modify or change these Terms from time to time with or without notice, and such changes will become effective immediately.

claims.text: Codes must be redeemed within 60 days of purchase

quote.text: You must redeem your code within 60 days of purchase

claims.text: IdeaBuddy provides tools to develop and validate business ideas

quote.text: IdeaBuddy provides a comprehensive suite of tools to assist in developing and validating business ideas.

claims.text: Includes business planning guide, financial tools, plan builder, Idea Plan canvas and validation tool

quote.text: Key features include a step-by-step business planning guide, financial planning tools, a business plan builder, an Idea Plan canvas for visualizing business models, and an idea validation tool to assess the feasibility of your concept.

claims.text: Idea Plan canvas maps business model with sticky notes and building blocks

quote.text: The Idea Plan canvas allows users to quickly map out their business model by using sticky notes to brainstorm ideas and connecting building blocks to define how the business will create value for target customers.

claims.text: Provides overview of business model and identifies internal and external factors

quote.text: It provides an overview of the business model and helps identify internal and external factors that may affect the business.

claims.text: Users can invite team members and mentors to brainstorm together

quote.text: Yes, IdeaBuddy enables collaboration by allowing users to invite team members and mentors to brainstorm together.

claims.text: Collaborators can view or edit progress directly in the platform

quote.text: Collaborators can be given access to view or edit progress directly within the platform.

claims.text: AI tools support every step of the planning journey

quote.text: Yes, IdeaBuddy incorporates AI-powered tools to support users at every step of their planning journey.

claims.text: AI provides tailored suggestions, revenue and expense estimates, and multilingual writing assistance

quote.text: The AI provides tailored suggestions, helps estimate revenues and expenses, and offers writing assistance in multiple languages.

claims.text: Users can export Canvas, Financial Plan, or Business Plan as Word, PDF, or Excel

quote.text: Users can export their Canvas, Financial Plan, or Business Plan as Word documents, PDFs, or Excel files.

claims.text: Users can share a link with partners and investors

quote.text: Additionally, they can share a link with partners and investors.

claims.text: Financial Plan creates projections using AI suggestions and automated calculators

quote.text: IdeaBuddy's Financial Plan feature helps users create realistic financial projections by using AI suggestions and automated financial calculators.

claims.text: Validation tool evaluates strength and viability of business idea

quote.text: The idea validation tool helps users quickly evaluate the strength and viability of their business idea.

claims.text: Provides idea templates with industry-based business guides

quote.text: Yes, IdeaBuddy provides idea templates with industry-based business guides.

claims.text: Mobile-friendly access to work on ideas on the go

quote.text: Yes, IdeaBuddy is mobile-friendly, allowing users to work on their ideas from the palm of their hand.

finePrint.summary: AI features are limited by credits that refill each billing cycle, so a lifetime buyer would still face ongoing usage caps.

quote.text: Get smart suggestions and enhance your writing automatically with our new AI Assistance feature. Request credits refill with each billing cycle.

finePrint.summary: AI credits expire with the plan period and refill each cycle, limiting how much AI a lifetime buyer can bank or carry over.

quote.text: The validity of AI request credits aligns with your plan's duration and is refilled at the end of each billing cycle.

finePrint.summary: Each plan limits how many business ideas or projects you can hold at once, though slots can be reused by deleting old ones.

quote.text: An idea slot can be any type of a project you would like to work on.

finePrint.summary: Paid plans come with a 15-day full refund if you are not satisfied.

quote.text: Not fully satisfied with IdeaBuddy? We will refund 100% of your money within 15 days from the day of your purchase.

finePrint.summary: The terms state subscriptions are billed in advance and are non-refundable with no partial-month credits.

quote.text: The Service is billed in advance on a monthly or annual basis and is non-refundable.

finePrint.summary: The vendor can update the agreement or privacy policy at any time without notifying you.

quote.text: We may update this Agreement or the Privacy Policy at any time, without notification to you.

finePrint.summary: Changes to the terms can be made with or without notice and take effect immediately.

quote.text: Deep Blue Sea Studio may modify or change these Terms from time to time with or without notice, and such changes will become effective immediately.

finePrint.summary: The vendor can set or change monthly, annual, or one-time fees at any time.

quote.text: Rates: Deep Blue Sea Studio may from time to time determine, establish, or modify monthly and annual rates or one-time fees for the use of the Service.

finePrint.summary: The vendor can terminate the terms or service for any reason for all users or just you.

quote.text: Deep Blue Sea Studio may, according to its sole discretion, terminate these Terms, the Service or any service provided by it for any reason, whether the termination applies to all users or just to you.

finePrint.summary: Your stored ideas are kept only one month after expiry and then permanently deleted.

quote.text: All of entries and uploads in your IdeaBuddy account will be stored one month after the expiry of your subscription and then will be deleted permanently.

trials.claim: IdeaBuddy provides tools to develop and validate business ideas
trials.claimQuote: IdeaBuddy provides a comprehensive suite of tools to assist in developing and validating business ideas.
trials.reasoning: The terms define IdeaBuddy as a service to plan, model, and develop business ideas, and the vendor says it provides the tools to turn a vision into reality. The AI accuracy disclaimer and one report of lost work do not show the tools are not provided.

exhibits.quote: While these features are intended to assist in business planning, the outputs generated by ChatGPT may sometimes be inaccurate, incomplete, or unsuitable for your specific use.
exhibits.argument: The vendor disclaims accuracy and suitability of its AI-assisted planning outputs.

exhibits.quote: you go to save the work you've just written and find that it's gone.
exhibits.argument: A buyer reports the planning tool fails to save work, undermining development assistance.

exhibits.quote: We’ll provide you with all the tools you need to turn your vision into reality
exhibits.argument: Vendor states it provides all tools needed to turn vision into reality.

exhibits.quote: IdeaBuddy, a web-based subscription service that enables you to plan, model, and develop their business ideas.
exhibits.argument: Terms define IdeaBuddy as a service to plan, model and develop business ideas.

trials.claim: Includes business planning guide, financial tools, plan builder, Idea Plan canvas and validation tool
trials.claimQuote: Key features include a step-by-step business planning guide, financial planning tools, a business plan builder, an Idea Plan canvas for visualizing business models, and an idea validation tool to assess the feasibility of your concept.
trials.reasoning: The vendor confirms a step-by-step guide to building a business plan, and a buyer confirms business-model development, idea validation, and financial projections. The prosecution exhibits only describe limits on a free trial, not that the product lacks these features.

exhibits.quote: When you sign up, you get 15 days of free access to the Canvas, Guide, and Financial Plan.
exhibits.argument: Trial access omits Business Plan and Validation, so not all listed features are included.

exhibits.quote: You will have access to Canvas, Guide, and Financial Plan (with some limited options).
exhibits.argument: Even included tools are limited during trial, undermining the full-feature claim.

exhibits.quote: The step-by-step guide walks you through the entire process, from shaping an idea to building a robust business plan
exhibits.argument: Vendor confirms step-by-step guide for shaping idea into business plan.

exhibits.quote: make it incredibly easy to develop a solid business model, validate your idea, research the market, and create realistic financial projections without getting overwhelmed by complicated spreadsheets.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms tool develops business model, validates idea and creates financial projections.

trials.claim: Idea Plan canvas maps business model with sticky notes and building blocks
trials.claimQuote: The Idea Plan canvas allows users to quickly map out their business model by using sticky notes to brainstorm ideas and connecting building blocks to define how the business will create value for target customers.
trials.reasoning: No exhibits were admitted for this claim, so there is no evidence about the Idea Plan canvas, sticky notes, or building blocks.

themes.summary: Several users report lost work, save failures and inaccurate information.

hits.quote: you go to save the work you've just written and find that it's gone.
Lost the ideas I worked on a couple of times
IdeaBuddy no guarda ni muestra contenido: se pierde la información en “Problema del mercado” y “Solución” tras recargar la sección.

themes.summary: Many buyers say IdeaBuddy's structured guides, AI planning and validation help turn ideas into clear business plans.

hits.quote: What's great is that they have detailed guides and tips that help you with each step
the Idea Validation feature is excellent for giving you a clear picture of viability

themes.summary: Several buyers say the lifetime deal is worth the investment for entrepreneurs.

hits.quote: Worth every penny of the LTD.
Tier 1 will get the job done.

themes.summary: Multiple users say the PDF and Word export is useless for presenting to banks.

hits.quote: The idea is good, but at the end the export is useless.
Export feature lacks powerpoint; the point is to present your idea but they only have a pdf, word option

themes.summary: Buyers complain each code allows only one business idea, which feels restrictive for a lifetime deal.

hits.quote: each code only allows you to work on one idea.

themes.summary: A buyer says the delivered product does not match its promise and blocked progress.

hits.quote: At the moment the promise and the delivered product are out of alignment.
